name: Glass-ceramic cookware
summary: Oven and flame ware made of a white glass-ceramic, a glass that is crystallised by heat. The body takes the gas flame and the freezer, and a blue cornflower decal marks the early range.

philosophy.core_thesis: A cook wants one pot that goes from the freezer to the flame to the table, so the body is a glass that heat turns into a fine crystal ceramic.
design_principles: Melt a lithium-aluminosilicate glass with a nucleating agent, and form it as glass at about 1500 °C.
Heat the formed glass to about 750 to 1100 °C in a second step, called ceramming, so that fine crystals grow in it.
Leave the surface smooth, glossy and white; no separate glaze is added.
Use a wall 3 to 6 mm thick; keep the thickness even, so that the heat spreads.
Print a blue cornflower on the side with a decal in a low firing.
Fit a plastic handle or a glass lid with a rim that sits in the wall.
Make the shapes plain and round: a casserole, a saucepan, a skillet and a baking dish.
anti_patterns: A deep glossy glaze with pooling
A rim that is not reinforced

form.shape: Round and oval casseroles, saucepans with handles, skillets, loaf pans and covered baking dishes, made in matched sets.
form.profile: A straight wall that flares a little on a flat base; the lid is a glass dome with a knob.
form.foot_and_rim: A flat base that sits on a gas ring; a thick rolled rim that takes a lid and resists chips.
form.proportion: A 1.5-litre casserole is 20 cm wide and 9 cm high; wall 3 to 6 mm, rim 8 mm.
rules: Keep the wall even, so that the heat spreads and the pot does not crack.
Print the decal in the middle of the wall, in a band 4 to 6 cm high.
Match the lid to the pot in size and colour.

bodies.rule: Use the white glass-ceramic body, a crystal-in-glass material with almost no thermal expansion. Glass is for the lid and plastic for the handle. Porous clay bodies do not give a pan that goes from the freezer to the flame.

methods: pressing and blowing the glass in a mould
ceramming the formed glass in a controlled kiln
applying a decal to the side
fitting a handle or a lid
forming.joins: A handle of plastic or metal is bolted through two holes cast in the wall; a glass lid sits on a ledge.
forming.details: A mould seam on the base, a fine matte surface on the underside, and a smooth glassy face on the inside.

glaze.pattern: A blue cornflower in a band on the side, a plain white pot for the clean range, and in later years brown or green floral prints.
glaze.gloss: A smooth glassy gloss of about 80 to 95 GU; the surface is the body itself, with no added glaze.
glaze.wear: The decal fades after many washes; the white body stays clean and does not craze.

palette.strategy: A white body with one blue floral decal; later years use brown, green and orange prints of the same size.

firing.kiln: A tank furnace for the glass and a controlled heat treatment lehr for the ceramming.
processes: form the shape by pressing in a mould
hold the glass at about 750 °C so that crystals form
raise the heat to about 1100 °C to grow the crystals
fire the decal at a low heat
firing.scale: A factory line that made several million pieces a year; the pans went from the freezer to a gas flame and back.
firing.signs: A mould seam on the base, a smooth glassy surface with no glaze runs, and a decal band.

pieces.form: Round casserole with a glass lid and a blue cornflower band
Oval covered baking dish in plain white
Deep bowl with a side handle and a printed floral band
Small casserole with two ear handles in plain white

positive: smooth glossy surface with no glaze runs

canonical_works.work: Corning Ware saucepan with a plastic handle

evidence.title: Corning Ware and Visions Grab-It cookware

emotion.target_response: A clean, hopeful modern ease: the viewer sees a white pot with a blue flower and thinks of a bright kitchen of the 1960s.

use_cases: a retro kitchen set dressing of 1960
a museum label on early glass-ceramic ware
a cookware brief for a white, flameproof casserole
avoid_when: the brief needs a deep glaze effect
the brief needs a porous or rustic surface

modifiers.how: Change to a thick stoneware wall with a salt glaze and one cobalt brush stroke.
Change to white earthenware and replace the decal with four hand-banded blue stripes.

wall_thickness.note: A glass-ceramic wall is thin and even because the heat must spread.
